reason: The commit adds an ARM/NEON implementation of internal PNG row-filter operations without changing the public decoding entry point, initialization protocol, state requirements, or accepted input format. The existing harness already feeds arbitrary PNG bytes through spng_set_png_buffer() and reaches row filtering through spng_decode_image(), so no new input construction or API sequencing is required. Moreover, the added NEON block is guarded by SPNG_OPTIMIZER_FILTER while the surrounding configuration defines SPNG_OPTIMIZE_FILTER, so the supplied diff does not demonstrate that this new block is enabled at all.
evidence: The harness invokes the high-level decode path with spng_decoded_image_size() followed by spng_decode_image().
The harness gives the decoder direct control over arbitrary input bytes through spng_set_png_buffer(ctx, (void*)data, size).
All newly added functions are static internal filter routines; no new public API or caller-visible protocol appears in the diff.
The change adds SPNG_ARM architecture detection under SPNG_OPTIMIZE_FILTER but does not introduce new runtime initialization or configuration calls for callers.
The NEON implementation is conditionally compiled with '#if defined(SPNG_OPTIMIZER_FILTER) && defined(SPNG_ARM)', which does not match the visible SPNG_OPTIMIZE_FILTER macro name.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness unchanged; address or test the optimization's compile-time macro and architecture-specific build behavior separately from harness maintenance.
